cases.title: Double-click on the red centre, then on the angled DP text, of the DP1 downpipe: each time CE's Edit source window opens with DP1 and AutoCAD's attribute editor never appears
cases.plan_item: BUG-859 (B-001, PR 1834, switch doubleClick.sourceStopsAttributeEditorFirst), the red centre and DP text parts R09s leaves out
cases.expected: A double-click on the red centre of a freshly placed downpipe DP1 opens CE's 'Edit source' window with DP1 in its tag box, and AutoCAD's Enhanced Attribute Editor does not open; the title-bar Close closes it. A second double-click, on the angled DP text of the same downpipe, does the same. CE's structured log says 'EATTEDIT stopped before AutoCAD' twice.
cases.why_not_unit: Only real AutoCAD shows which window a double-click on each part of the symbol opens, and whether AutoCAD honours CE's refusal of its editor.
not_automated: The green label (BUG-860) is N42g. OK saving a changed tag is N42s (needs a permission). The outer circle is R09s.
Check 'editor absent 10 s later' cannot see an editor that close-windows closed first (the review's note on R09s); the window list read straight after the Edit source wait is the real guard.
DERIVED, not yet seen: that -Part insertion lands on the red centre and that the attribute tag is exactly DP. If the aim check reports a miss the step is BLOCKED, never a FAIL.
